teaser: Today, the Honourable Dominic LeBlanc, President of the King's Privy Council for Canada and Minister responsible for Canada-U.S. Trade, Intergovernmental Affairs, Internal Trade and One Canadian Economy, issued the following statement following the trilateral meeting of the fifth Free Trade Commission of the Canada-United States-Mexico Agreement (CUSMA):
title: Statement by Minister LeBlanc following trilateral CUSMA joint review meeting
